name: MedBridge-HalluBench
description: MedBridge-HalluBench v1: synthetic, single- and multi-turn patient and clinician messages for measuring hallucination and routing behaviour of the MedBridge Dual Answerability Gate (ANSWER / SOFT-ASK / GENERALIZE / ABSTAIN / ESCALATE). All items were written by hand for this benchmark; no real patient data (ADL-017). Gold evidence refers to the guideline corpus in data/corpus_manifest.json (27 documents, manifest_version 1; guideline_id plus 1-based page numbers of the PARSED documents, i.e. physical PDF pages, and for HTML sources the 1-based h1-h3 section index produced by medbridge.ingestion.html_parser), found by regex search over parsed text, never with the MedBridge retriever. Splits: stratified by category, dev_fraction=0.2, seed=42, via evaluation.datasets.schema.stratified_split (python -m evaluation.datasets.schema --dataset <file> --assign-splits <out> --seed 42 reproduces them). Use 'dev' only for calibration/threshold tuning; report on 'test'. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Documentation: evaluation/datasets/HALLUBENCH.md.
